verdict.rationale: Bento's FAQ claims developers see cost per run out of the box. The CLI docs mention a dashboard with analytics you can pull, so per-request cost visibility in a dashboard is supported only by a single thin vendor statement. missing for 10: token usage metrics, cost/token breakdown by model, time-period aggregation or filtering of cost in dashboards, detailed first-party docs on cost dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
